items.title: Cloudflare acquires Deno
items.title_zh: Cloudflare 收购 Deno，独立运行时开发宣告终止
items.title_en: Cloudflare acquires Deno, ending independent runtime development
items.summary: Cloudflare has acquired Deno in what the community describes as an acquihire that will end active Deno runtime development after one year of maintenance releases.

items.title: Quoting Matthew Green
items.title_zh: Matthew Green：有15%的概率人类会失去对公钥加密的信心
items.title_en: Matthew Green: 15% Chance We Lose Confidence in Public-Key Encryption
items.summary: Matthew Green warns that there is a small but real chance we functionally lose confidence in existing public-key encryption, and that AI's pace of surprises vastly outruns our ability to update standards without advance preparation.

items.title: 中国天眼 FAST 发现脉冲星原生三体
items.title_zh: 中国天眼 FAST 发现脉冲星原生三体系统
items.title_en: China's FAST Telescope Finds Primordial Pulsar Triple System
items.summary: 中国天眼 FAST 发现并由中欧科学家独立确认首例仍在演化阶段的脉冲星原生三体系统，成果发表于《天体物理学杂志快报》。

items.title: JetBrains 发布开源编程模型 Mellum2.1
items.title_zh: JetBrains 发布开源编程模型 Mellum2.1，Apache 2.0 许可
items.title_en: JetBrains Releases Mellum2.1, an Apache 2.0 Coding Agent Model
items.summary: JetBrains released Mellum2.1, an open-source 12B-parameter mixture-of-experts coding model with 2.5B active parameters, Apache 2.0 license, and real-environment RL training for local coding agents.
